t: The exchange rate, stated in both directions
a: إِذَا أَحْسَنَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِسْلاَمَهُ، فَكُلُّ حَسَنَةٍ يَعْمَلُهَا تُكْتَبُ لَهُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا إِلَى سَبْعِمِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ، وَكُلُّ سَيِّئَةٍ يَعْمَلُهَا تُكْتَبُ لَهُ بِمِثْلِهَا
p: Idhā aḥsana aḥadukum islāmah, fa-kullu ḥasanatin yaʿmaluhā tuktabu lahu bi-ʿashri amthālihā ilā sabʿimiʾati ḍiʿf, wa kullu sayyiʾatin yaʿmaluhā tuktabu lahu bi-mithlihā
m: When one of you makes his Islam good, every good deed he does is written for him ten times over, up to seven hundred times. And every bad deed he does is written as one.
